planets.name: TOI-1246 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1246 with a 4.31-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1246 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-1246. Its orbit and size follow Turtelboom et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
